findings: The reduced archived gallery changes from three to four pages when nine cards are reduced to one or emptied, with near-identical root and gallery screen bounds.
A standalone clipped flex gallery reproduces print shrinking with absolute headers or ratio boxes containing absolute descendants; in-flow fixed-height and padding-based headers do not reproduce it.
Six final fixtures use 30 ordinary 100px paragraph blocks rather than a monolithic filler; no forced-fragmentation diagnostic remains.
Chromium marker height changes from 16.757812 points to 11.171875 points in both nine-card positioned cases, establishing a two-thirds scale. OfficeIMO stays at four pages in all six cases.
limits: Archive beforeprint/afterprint hooks did not execute. Standalone hooks execute but sample screen geometry, so neither proves internal paginated overflow bounds.
This establishes a reachable print-compatibility difference; it does not justify ignoring every overflow clip or claim NASA parity.
